response: The continuity-of-care experiences of vascular trainees in an academic vascular department are suboptimal, particularly for postoperative clinic assessments. Same-day admission surgery, which accounts for most cases, is associated with the poorest continuity of care. To provide complete surgical training, vascular programs must be creative in structuring training to include adequate ambulatory experience, especially in an era of changing therapeutic modalities and same-day admission surgery. This suggests that trainees may not be learning complete surgical care due to the current structure of their training programs.
